name: Window Geometry
description: Restores each window's position, size, workspace and maximize/fullscreen state across restarts with zero visible teleport. Unlike smart-auto-move, it identifies the window by wm_class at the initial xdg configure and writes the geometry into the MetaWindowConfig *before the client's first buffer is presented*, so the window is never painted at the wrong place for even one frame. Fixed-size windows (splash screens, fixed-size game windows) are remembered under their own key, separate from the app's resizable windows, so a splash can never claim the main window's slot. Browser Picture-in-Picture windows (matched by title) likewise get their own key; the first PiP spawns in the bottom-right corner of the work area, and a PiP resize snaps to 16:9 on release. Native-Wayland toplevels only.
